# Ivan Karabeinikau — Product Engineer and Frontend Architect

Ivan Karabeinikau helps product teams, startups, and fintech companies turn ideas and complex requirements into reliable digital products. His work covers product discovery, UX, frontend architecture, React and Next.js development, supporting Node.js services, deployment automation, and production delivery.

## Services

- End-to-end product and MVP development
- Frontend architecture for React, Next.js, and TypeScript applications
- Stabilization and refactoring of legacy frontend codebases
- Fintech calculators, dashboards, and data-heavy interfaces
- Internal tools, CI/CD automation, and AI-assisted development workflows
